I haven't saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki yet, because it needs approval first. I've replied to Dana in this DM to explain.

- **Why it's on hold:** the directory lists Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) as Central team lead. The admin rule says per-seat rates go only to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark and the account owner. Hollis isn't any of those, so the $2,356 rate can't go to him unless June or Anselm approves. Being the account owner lets Dana see the figure herself, but she can't pass it on to him. I treated saving a draft to him as the same as sending it. The rule only says "not even as a draft" for mail outside pemberline.com, so that part is my call.
- **Approval:** I logged a request for June Osei-Lark (status: pending) and asked for sign-off in the reply to Dana's message here. I didn't message June directly, because that would have meant passing on what Dana told me privately.
- **Next step:** once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft to Hollis with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" for Dana to send. In the meantime I offered Dana a version without the rate that points Hollis to her.
